Maria: Heads up — saw a quality regression when we quantized fusion-7b to int4 with softpad tokens enabled. Short repro at gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/fusion-int4-softpad

Ken: Can you paste the eval command and a minimal output? I want to run locally.

Maria: Sure, command:
```
python -m rdl.eval --model fusion-7b --quant int4 --softpad True --input samples/softpad_prompt.txt
```
Output snippet:
```
> prompt: "Summary:"
logits[10:15] int8 vs fp16: [-3.2, -1.1, 0.0, 2.3, -0.5] vs [-0.1, -0.2, 0.9, 1.8, -0.4]
```
Seems like headwise phase is flipped for some tokens.

Adele: Interesting — could be head order mismatch after our proj transpose change. Fusion uses head-concatenated layout in the onnx export; we assume interleaved. :thinking_face: 

Pranav: If head order is wrong, kv cache indexing would be off. Check q,k projections ordering and also rotary apply axis. Try printing q shape before reshape.

Maria: Did that. q shape pre-reshape: (batch, seq, 128, 64) — iirc expected (batch, seq, 64, 128) for interleaved vs concat? Paste logs: `q pre-reshape dims: (1,32,64,128)`

Ken: That confirms mismatch. Our fusion->redwood conversion step uses `head_dim_first=True` for most models; maybe Fusion export sets `head_dim_first=False`. Fix by swapping axes in converter: `q = q.transpose(2,3)` before reshape.

Maria: Applied local patch and re-ran quant eval — logits align much better. Quick diff:
```
before: top token prob 0.06
after: top token prob 0.52
```

Adele: Nice! We should add a converter test that asserts `(q.reshape(...).transpose(...))` pattern for fusion. Also add a softpad token integration test — I think padding sentinel changes rotary phase indexing.

Pranav: Agreed. I'll open a PR to add converters test + an int4 smoke for softpad. Tagging infra for CI: @Ken can you add a job with small sequence length but both softpad on/off?

Ken: Yep will add. Filing follow-up issues: #9123 converter headorder, #9124 softpad-rotary-smoke. :white_check_mark:

build-bot: CI triggered for PR #4567 — converters/fusion-headorder-fix
